resources.string: Play at your own pace. Get a new number using the button. Times are not saved.
Adjust language and appearance using the controls above.

Goal: Select cards until their total matches the target. Each stack contains four cards worth 6, 7, 8, or 9.

Tap a card to select it or put it back. Reset returns only the cards, the stopwatch is unchanged.

Free Play: The stopwatch stops when you first reach the target. Use “New random number” to start another round. Times are not saved.

5er / 10er: Solve five or ten targets. Each correct total automatically generates a new target. Your total time is saved to the local scoreboard after the final round.

The stopwatch pauses in the background. Unfinished games are not saved.

Adjust language and light/dark mode on the home screen.

Free Play

The stopwatch stops when you first reach the target. Use “New random number” to start another round and reset the time.

Times are not saved. The Home button returns directly to the home screen.

Choose a mode:

Free Play: Individual targets without saved times.

5er / 10er: Solve five or ten targets in a row. Total time is saved to a separate local scoreboard for each mode.

Use the icons above to choose your language, light/dark mode, and color theme.

The scoreboards show the three fastest completed runs for each mode.

Select cards until their total matches the target. Each stack contains four cards worth 6, 7, 8, or 9.\n\nTap a card to select it or put it back. Reset returns only the cards. The stopwatch pauses while this help is open or the app is in the background.

Solve %1$d targets in a row. Each correct total automatically generates a new number and returns the cards to their stacks.

The stopwatch measures total time. After the final target, it stops and the result is saved to the local %1$der scoreboard.

Reset does not affect total time. Leaving an unfinished run using Home discards it.
